newsitem.title: USA: Glaxo HIV inhibitor shows activity.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo HIV inhibitor shows activity.

text.p: A drug being developed by Glaxo Wellcome Plc to fight HIV has been shown to have "significant" anti-viral activity with minor side effects for the patient, the company said Monday.
Glaxo Wellcome said the activity of the HIV protease inhibitor, known as 141W94 (VX-478), increased with larger doses, according to preliminary results of a study.

The drug, discovered by Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc and developed by Glaxo Wellcome and Kissei Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, only gave patients mild side effects such as diarrhea when administered orally, it said.
Glaxo Wellcome said the results were presented at the 36th Interscience Conference on Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy.
